name: Chaotic Conundrum
detailed_description:
Chaotic Conundrum is a blazing-fast 2D retro platformer with smooth-as-silk controls, expressive movement options, and tight physics, adorned with a GBA-SNES flair that looks more like a drug trip than anything, and a rockin' dynamic soundtrack.

Giga-Boy has stolen every single cheeseburger on the planet in a fit of rage, as his pig intestine chowder business unsurprisingly bombed. A 12-year-old cheeseburger enthusiast, Fernan Ricemeat, grabs his reluctant younger sister Frieda and his closest friend FJ to set off on the adventure of a lifetime – only to accidentally destroy all of time and space in the process. Whoops!

Find all the Hyper Rock shards, beat Giga-Boy's ass, and save burgers before they're history!!

LIGHTS, CHAOS, ACTION!

Sprint, jump, and beat up any baddies you find across dozens of speedrun-oriented stages. Look out for 5 burgers hidden in each stage, and be sure to book it to the exit after grabbing that Hyper Rock shard. But as a twist to the tradition, at the end of each stage you'll FLIP OUT!! So carve an escape route and beat it before you're part of the history books!

Combos are a big part of gameplay. The higher combo you have, the higher your Star Multiplier will be, boosting your earnings. The more you wreck, the more you gain!

That's not all, though! There are myriads of marvelous mechanics to mess around with in each and every level! Turn into a bouncing music note, freeze into solid ice and break things recklessly, turn into a soda cup to destroy acid walls and much more! Every single stage has something new for you to enjoy.

FEATURING...

  • Blistering-fast, yet smooth-as-silk gameplay!

  • Wreak havoc in dozens of unique and expansive "episodes", each with hours of replay value!

  • 5 burgers to collect in each level!

  • 3 playable characters, each with their own abilities, whom you can swap between on the fly!

  • Fully voiced animated cutscenes, tying the story together!

  • Hundreds of achievements to keep you coming back for more!

  • Cosmetics aplenty! No microtransactions, all unlocked in gameplay!

  • Time trials - think you can beat the developers at their own game?

  • Spicy Mode - a race against Giga-Boy in each stage... for super players!

  • Obo

Please keep in mind that this game is still in active development. As such, all assets, level designs, and gameplay components are not final and subject to change.

short_description: Hit the ground running in the craziest platformer you've ever laid your eyes on. Featuring breakneck gameplay, eccentric characters, a grafitti-90's artstyle and a rockin' dynamic soundtrack.
